text:
Aisha: Heads up — Tidewell (org_id=tidewell-82) has a ~75% token usage drop over the last 6 weeks and active seats fell 12 -> 3. Renewal in ~45 days and procurement just handed to Ben (new IT lead). LumenAI reported running a pilot. Need quick triage and next steps.

Rahul: +1. Can you paste org ID, last deploy window, and any error spikes?

Aisha: org_id=tidewell-82, last_deploy=2024-11-05. API throughput looks steady but seats/tokens collapsed starting ~2024-10-20. Tokens/mo 1.2M -> ~320k. No config changes on our side.

alerts-bot: [usage_anomaly] Tidewell (tidewell-82) — 74% drop in tokens over 30d. Details: https://redwood/alerts/1823334444 :warning:

James: Can you share which model/route they hit? I can pull traces and kv-cache stats.

Aisha: Route: `/generate-chat` default model `gpt-mid-16k`, fallback `gpt-small-8k`. They do a mix of streaming and batch. No obvious rollout from our side.

James: Running quick query...
```sql
SELECT day, tokens, active_seats FROM usage WHERE org='tidewell-82' ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30;
```

James: Early look shows a 5xx spike ~2024-10-28 then sustained low usage — suspect their integration retried then switched to offline batch.

Marta: Support saw repeated `ClientTimeout` from their staging integration on 2024-10-28. I opened ticket #78921 and pinged their eng.

Olivia: I'm meeting Ben (procurement) tomorrow 2pm PT. I'll raise a short pilot offer + workshop for their new PM. Any collateral we prefer?

Aisha: Use the "usage-surge-to-book" playbook. Offer 50% pilot credit, highlight Dedicated latency SLA and rollback-safe canary. Suggested opener: "Ben — quick check: what are your throughput SLOs and internal approval timeline?"

Rahul: Proposed owners: Olivia = outreach/renewal touch; James = diagnostics & logs; Marta = support ticket owner. I'll schedule a 30m triage call for 2024-11-12 11:00 PT and update the risk tag.

Olivia: Adding Ben + their PM Sara to the invite. Can someone prep a 1-slide ROI map (tokens -> cost) and a short runbook for PoC?

James: I'll export model metrics (latency, kv cache hit, 5xx rate) and share logs by EOD.

Aisha: Also ask them explicitly if they're evaluating LumenAI — need to capture competitive reasons (cost, features, infra). I'll draft a 1-page comp doc and outreach script.

Olivia: Can someone jump on a 15m prep before the call? :eyes:

Marta: I'll join prep. James, please post the logs link in thread.

James: Logs posted: https://redwood/logs/tidewell-82/trace-1823334444 — includes tail and kvcache metrics.

Rahul: I'll add a short checklist to CRM: cause analysis, outreach, pilot offer, support remediation, competitive notes, renewal risk level.

Aisha: Action items recap: (1) Outreach & invite — Olivia (2) Diagnostics & logs — James (3) Support ticket follow-up — Marta (4) Comp doc + ROI slide — Aisha. I'll update the account page and tag renewal-risk:high.

Olivia: Thanks — will report back after Ben sync. :thumbsup:
